admission: timeline_validate and timeline_map are admitted as tools 47 and 48 (tests/test_s4a_tool_admission.py); the nine condense stage tools, condense_publish included, as tools 49-57 (tests/test_s4b_tool_admission.py). The tools below equal the admitted descriptors. tool_api.validate_schema has no pattern or uniqueItems support and bounds arrays at 128 items, so per-op query fields, unique checks and the talk.toml path rules are enforced in scripts/tool_api.py before any worker starts.

tools.name: timeline_validate
tools.title: Validate a condense EDL with the Rust timeline
tools.description: Run `video-utils timeline validate` on an edl.json and return its receipt: fps, clips, segments, total frames and seconds, the largest frame drift and the file's sha256, or a typed reason (edl_invalid family, too_large, edl_unreadable). Reads one file; writes nothing.
tools.intent: Give agents the Rust authority's verdict on an EDL before render, publish or verify-run.

edl.description: A regular edl.json written by the condense edl stage (not a symlink; at most 16 MiB).

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the Rust timeline call in seconds.

limitations: Validation proves the EDL's internal contract (frames, contiguity, cuts, totals), not that the edit sounds right or keeps every word.

dependencies.note: The EDL comes from the condense edl stage.

agent_workflow.identify: Read status, reason, detail, total_frames and max_drift_frames.
agent_workflow.research: src/timeline.rs holds the contract; docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md the manifest side.
agent_workflow.iterate: There are no knobs; fix the EDL's producer, never the validator.
agent_workflow.acceptance: status ok is required before render or publish; it is not listening acceptance.

tools.name: timeline_map
tools.title: Map source and output times through a condense EDL
tools.description: Answer a batch of to_out (clip, source_s, snap), to_src (output_s) and row (clip, source_s) queries against an edl.json with `video-utils timeline map`. Returns one result per query in order; null where a time is dropped or past the end. Reads one file; writes nothing.
tools.intent: Let agents place captions, corrections and review notes on the output clock, or find the source moment under an output time, with the same arithmetic the render used.

edl.description: A regular edl.json written by the condense edl stage (not a symlink; at most 16 MiB).

queries.description: At most 128 queries per call (the registry bound for arrays). to_out needs clip and source_s (snap optional); row needs clip and source_s; to_src needs output_s.

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the Rust timeline call in seconds.

limitations: Source times are per-clip analysis seconds from the first decoded audio sample; add the clip's shift for the recording's own clock.

dependencies.note: A map on an invalid EDL refuses with the validator's reason.

agent_workflow.identify: Match each result to its query by position; a null is a dropped span or past the end.
agent_workflow.research: condense/README.md 'edl' explains kinds, cuts and the join.
agent_workflow.iterate: Use snap to move a time inside a cut to its join.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A mapped time is arithmetic on the EDL, not evidence about what was said there.

tools.name: condense_transcribe
tools.title: Transcribe talk recordings with whisper.cpp
tools.description: Extract 16 kHz analysis audio and run whisper.cpp twice per ~800 s chunk (a beam pass and a DTW pass) with the registered ggml-small.en model. Reads the clip recordings and the registered model; writes work/<clip>.16k.wav, .pass1.json and .dtw.json beneath the config's work/out paths. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply, and no guitar tool accepts its outputs (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Let an agent run the condense transcribe stage on one talk with bounded time and typed failures, and inspect what it wrote.

config.description: A regular talk.toml (not a symlink). Its clip files, work directory and output resolve relative to it and must stay beneath its directory; no output may overwrite a clip file.

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the whole call in seconds; each tool call inside it is also bounded by CONDENSE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_S (7200 s).

limitations: Synthetic-media tests cover the stage; listening quality, ASR accuracy and physical A/V sync beyond the avsync probe are not established.
Refuses without the registered, hash-verified model in models/; never downloads it (just condense-model is a separate explicit step).
DTW word starts can run up to 0.6 s early; pass 1 hears more words with looser times.

dependencies.note: Stages read the files the earlier stage left in work/; they are not run automatically.

agent_workflow.identify: Read the stage's printed summary and the files it wrote (work/<clip>.16k.wav, .pass1.json and .dtw.json).
agent_workflow.research: condense/README.md gives every rule and default; docs/spec/CONDENSE.md gives ownership.
agent_workflow.iterate: Change one talk.toml number, rerun this stage and the ones after it, and compare.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A finished stage is not an accepted edit: condense_check gates the render and a person reads the bounds report.

tools.name: condense_check
tools.title: Gate a rendered edit
tools.description: Run the named checks (default all): silence (no 1.0 s gap at -35 dB), loud (within 1 LU, true peak under 0 dBTP), sync (probe and real, within 20 ms) and bounds (whisper re-reads at cuts for a person). Reads the output and edl.json; writes a printed report only beneath the config's work/out paths. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply, and no guitar tool accepts its outputs (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).

checks.description: Checks to run, each at most once; all when omitted.

tools.name: condense_recover
tools.title: Rebuild a truncated .mov with untrunc
tools.description: Rebuild a recording with no moov atom from a healthy reference made by the same device and app, then report packets found, duration and the share of bytes recovered; fails under 90%. Refuses to overwrite an existing output. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply, and no guitar tool accepts its outputs (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Recover a talk recording cut off by a full disk or a crash before condensing it.

reference.description: A long healthy .mov from the same device and app (regular file).

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the whole call in seconds; each tool call inside it is also bounded by CONDENSE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_S (7200 s).

limitations: untrunc exits 1 even on a full rebuild; the verdict comes from its log and the byte share.
A short reference rebuilds only part of a long file.

dependencies.note: Run before condense_transcribe when a recording does not open.

agent_workflow.identify: Read the Found/Duration lines and the byte share; the log sits beside the output.
agent_workflow.iterate: Try a longer reference from the same session.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A rebuilt file still needs a look and a listen; its audio can run longer than its video.

tools.name: condense_publish
tools.title: Publish a hash-bound condense run
tools.description: Copy the delivered edit, edl.json and whichever captions and corrected copy exist into a fresh artifacts/condense/<run_id>/ with a manifest whose timeline mapping is edl_v1, then verify it with `video-utils verify-run --timeline edl_v1`; a run that fails the check is kept as .failed-<run_id> and the call fails. Reads the config's out and work paths; the output root is fixed (repository artifacts/condense) and there is no output field. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply, and no guitar tool accepts its outputs (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Let an agent run the condense publish stage on one talk with bounded time and typed failures, and inspect what it wrote.

config.description: A regular talk.toml (not a symlink). Its clip files, work directory and output resolve relative to it and must stay beneath its directory; no output may overwrite a clip file.

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the whole call in seconds; each tool call inside it is also bounded by CONDENSE_TOOL_TIMEOUT_S (7200 s).

limitations: The manifest binds hashes and the EDL timeline; listening quality, ASR accuracy and physical A/V sync beyond the avsync probe are not established.
Each call writes a new run; earlier runs are never changed or removed.

dependencies.note: Stages read the files the earlier stage left in work/; they are not run automatically.

agent_workflow.identify: Read the printed run directory, file count and frame total; the manifest and verify-run receipt sit in it.
agent_workflow.research: condense/README.md gives every rule and default; docs/spec/CONDENSE.md gives ownership.
agent_workflow.iterate: Publish again after a new render; compare runs by their manifests.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A verified run proves the hashes and the timeline mapping, not that the edit is accepted.
